regimeSub: Hot August CPI +3.7% YoY cements Warsh September hike; 10Y at 4.96% as oil shock persists.
themes: August CPI +3.7% YoY (vs 3.5% prior) per Reuters Sep 13 'consumer prices accelerate' → 2Y yields surge +26bp MoM to 4.63%; Warsh Jackson Hole 'inflation progress insufficient' signals imminent hike at Sep 17 FOMC
Brent $106.99 as WSJ Sep 15 reports Saudi output slumps on Houthi Red Sea port seizure → energy pass-through keeps core PCE at 3.3%; Hormuz ceasefire failing to stabilize flows despite June deal
10Y Treasury hits 4.96% (19-year high) → SPX -2.1% MoM to 7619; Q2 GDP 1.5% YoY with retail sales -0.6% MoM confirms consumer buckling under 150bp+ real rates
BOK flags chip boom inflation risk per Korea Times Sep 10 after back-to-back hikes to 3.0% → won weakens to 1353 despite HBM demand; KOSPI -0.8% WoW as duration selloff pressures semis

headline: Fed Chair Warsh locked into September rate hike as August CPI +3.7% and Brent above $105 keep stagflation trade alive with 10Y yields at 19-year highs crushing equity multiples.
